import json,hashlib,ipaddress
def derive(seed,w,s,net):
    m=("ipv6-evidence-v1\n"+str(seed)+"\n"+w+"\n"+s+"\n"+net+"\n").encode()
    d=hashlib.sha256(m).digest(); return int.from_bytes(d[:8],'big')|(1<<63)
base=2001
net=ipaddress.IPv6Network("2001:db8::/64")
base_int=int(net.network_address)
c0=derive(5,"w","s","2001:db8::/64")
ct0=str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(base_int|c0))
ct1=str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(base_int|(c0^1)))
t1=str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(base_int|1)); t2=str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(base_int|2))
